mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_api_document_chunks ( document_id, detail_id, chunk_type, chunk_no, chunk_title, chunk_text, source_path, source_url, sort_order, content_hash, index_status ) VALUES ( #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.detailId}, #{chunk.chunkType}, #{chunk.chunkNo}, #{chunk.chunkTitle}, #{chunk.chunkText}, #{chunk.sourcePath}, #{chunk.sourceUrl}, #{chunk.sortOrder}, #{chunk.contentHash}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.target = #{target} AND doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') )

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, c.chunk_type AS chunkType, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.target = #{target} AND doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, doc.title, c.sort_order LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, NULL AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN law_api_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) AND ( #{query} = '' OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.agency_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) AND ( e.chunk_id IS NULL OR e.status IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR') OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, doc.target, c.chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, NULL AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE c.chunk_id IN
#{chunkId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_api_chunk_embeddings ( chunk_id, embedding_model, vector_store, vector_point_id, content_hash, status, embedded_at, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{chunkId}, #{model}, #{vectorStore}, #{vectorPointId}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, NOW(), #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_point_id = VALUES(vector_point_id), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), status = VALUES(status), embedded_at = VALUES(embedded_at), last_error_message = VALUES(last_error_message)
mapper.update: UPDATE law_api_chunk_embeddings e JOIN law_api_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id SET e.status = 'FAILED', e.last_error_message = 'Recovered stale BATCH_SUBMITTED without active batch job.', e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'BATCH_SUBMITTED' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.embedded_at, NOW()) >= #{staleMinutes} AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc JOIN semantic_batch_jobs bj ON bj.batch_job_id = bjc.batch_job_id WHERE bjc.chunk_id = e.chunk_id AND bj.target = doc.target AND bj.status IN ('validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing') )
